placeName.zh-CN: 中国河北省张家口市崇礼区

details.direction: From Celebration Square through Genting, Wanlong, Taiwoo, Xueruyi and the other core ski areas and Olympic venues, looping through the Chongli mountains back to Celebration Square. Chongli 168 is a closed loop with 80% natural trail.
details.distanceMethod: 2026 official regulations and course page give 170.7 km; this page does not average conflicting figures.
details.elevationMethod: Chongli 168 8,292 m; Chongli 100 5,105 m; Xueruyi 70 3,193 m; Wanlong 50 2,448 m; Yunding 30 1,283 m
details.attribution: 崇礼168 2026：冬奥雪场、山野路径与 170.7 公里的 48 小时 / Chongli 168 2026: Olympic ski slopes, mountain trails and 170.7 km in 48 hours. Race facts from the 2026 official notices and host-city government pages; editorial schematic only, no official track bundled.
